breadcrumbs.name: Ntag216 NFC Stickers — 888-byte High-memory NFC Tags For Vcards & Complex Payloads

summary: NTAG216 is NXP's highest-memory standard NFC sticker chip — 888 bytes of user memory, six times more than NTAG213. It is the right choice for electronic business cards (vCards) with complete contact details, multi-record NDEF payloads, smart packaging with embedded product data, and any application where a single tap must deliver a rich data payload without a URL redirect. Available wholesale with NDEF pre-encoding and variable data encoding per sticker.
